description: Make every defimpl an independently-demandable Protocol.Target module AND repoint dispatch to demand it directly (merged former T2). Add ModuleSourceKind::ProtocolImpl carrying resolved protocol/target/owner ids + body surface, resolved name-accurately against the defimpl's own lexical namespace (folds in .14). Discovery registers Protocol.Target as its own module source (index + scope); define_module gains a ProtocolImpl arm that publishes the impl (extracted from define_protocol_impl: define callbacks, world.define_protocol_impl, refresh ProtocolDispatch). resolve_protocol_call miss-path demands DefineModule(Protocol.Target) for each (protocol,target) whose target overlaps the receiver, NOT the host module. Remove inline-define in apply_scope_form and the provider-pointer-to-host indirection. Keep the (protocol,target) index as the discovery surface. runtime_impl_target_modules stays until T5. Signal: Mini fixture resolves by defining only Susp.List; root-level defimpl still dispatches.
title: Register each defimpl as an independent Protocol.Target module body source
